Name: Jurisdiction ValueSet
Title: Jurisdiction
Description: This value set defines a base set of codes for country, country subdivision and region    for indicating where a resource is intended to be used.             Note: The codes for countries and country subdivisions are taken from    [ISO 3166](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html)    while the codes for "supra-national" regions are from    [UN Standard country or area codes for statistical use (M49)](http://unstats.un.org/unsd/methods/m49/m49.htm).

Name: CommonLanguages
Title: Common Languages
Description: This value set includes common codes from BCP-47 (http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47)

Name: PublicationStatus
Title: PublicationStatus

Name: ResourceType
Title: ResourceType
Description: One of the resource types defined as part of this version of FHIR.

Name: SearchComparator
Title: SearchComparator

Name: SearchModifierCode
Title: SearchModifierCode

Name: SearchParamType
Title: SearchParamType

Name: XPathUsageType
Title: XPathUsageType
Description: How a search parameter relates to the set of elements returned by evaluating its xpath query.

Name: SPDXLicense
Title: SPDXLicense
Description: The license that applies to an Implementation Guide (using an SPDX license Identifiers, or 'not-open-source'). The binding is required but new SPDX license Identifiers are allowed to be used (https://spdx.org/licenses/).
